title: cassuvium anacardium
intro: Cassuvium anacardium, commonly known as the poison tree or cashew tree, is a plant species in the family Anacardiaceae. The health benefits of Cassuvium anacardium include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. Cassuvium anacardium contains bioactive constituents such as anacardic acid, cardol, and cardanol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
